name: chart
summary: Experimental request-time SVG chart from a closed typed renderer contract.

agent.useWhen: A bounded, persisted time series needs a server-rendered line or bar visualization with an accessible values table.
agent.avoidWhen: A client-owned dashboard, arbitrary chart callbacks, unbounded datasets, or a host without approved runtime presentation support is required.

contract.role: accessible request-time chart with exact values table
invariants: This is an experimental draft component; Native runtime presentation remains adapter-required and this metadata makes no readiness claim.
Only id, data, label and enhance are accepted. id and label are stable, literal, nonblank values; enhance is the literal true or false and defaults false.

data is exactly one whole dotted identifier record path. Calls, indexing, operators, mixed interpolation and raw JSON are rejected; normal Native admission checks ui_scene input/output against the locked renderer contract.
The renderer receives only current typed query data. No engine is executed during package expansion, static preview, or app build.
The SVG uses a stable root id, derived caption and clip ids, one plot-derived clip rectangle, ordered renderer paths, escaped labels, and only closed paint roles 0 through 4.
An accessible exact-values table distinguishes explicit missing samples from measured numeric zero and contains every input sample.
The hidden point mapping is bounded by the renderer contract and contains only key, time, value, missing, x and y data attributes.

No-JavaScript SVG and table output are complete. The root figure is the enhancement boundary and carries bounded range values; bounded hidden point spans expose only renderer key, time, value, missing, x and y fields.

When enabled, the separate admitted installer owns Previous, Next, Inspect, Start selection, Apply and Cancel controls plus preview SVG layers; the declarative fragment adds no toolbar. Its bubbled application events are cui-chart:range-committed {start,end}, cui-chart:range-cancelled {}, and cui-chart:point-activated {key,time,value,missing}; teardown also dispatches a document-scoped cui-chart:unmounted lifecycle notification. App code owns navigation and dialogs.
The renderer contract is the locked input/output schema for echarts_chart_v1 ABI 1. It is metadata, not executable approval or runtime authorization.

tokenDescriptions.name: --cui-chart-axis
tokenDescriptions.purpose: Colors the SVG scene frame; axis strokes use the separate ink token.

tokenDescriptions.name: --cui-chart-grid
tokenDescriptions.purpose: Colors renderer grid strokes without changing measured series geometry.

tokenDescriptions.name: --cui-chart-ink
tokenDescriptions.purpose: Colors axis strokes and the optional inspection crosshair.

tokenDescriptions.name: --cui-chart-orange
tokenDescriptions.purpose: Colors measured series, selection previews, inspection markers, controls and focus outlines.

tokenDescriptions.name: --cui-chart-surface
tokenDescriptions.purpose: Colors the SVG background, outlined point interiors and optional controls.

tokenDescriptions.name: --cui-chart-text
tokenDescriptions.purpose: Colors figure text, SVG labels, the exact-values table and inspection status.

native.scope: Experimental expansion requires independently approved Native presentation ABI 1 and echarts_chart_v1 schemas. Query-backed SVG and exact-values rendering is implemented; optional interaction still requires complete browser/lifecycle qualification. Worker provisioning is separate from Native UI bundles. Not a ready or released component.
